_comment: reference: the optimizer's solution.  h, r, x and alpha (= y^Max) are the
four decision variables; k is the velocity scale s_U, fixed by requiring
the candidate and the target to agree at y_ref rather than by a
least-squares fit over the whole profile.
y_ref is a height in the units of the target's y column, and defaults to
H_build.  It is not a ratio: the same building gives a different ratio
depending on how far above it the target profile was specified.
